description: Retrieve an eight-digit rate line or exact ten-digit statistical number with all published General, Special and Column 2 cells. An explicit eight-digit row takes precedence; an absent one resolves only through a unique ten-digit source row, retaining its identity. Multiple suffixes stay unresolved. Blank statistical cells inherit only from the matching eight-digit legal ancestor. With countryCode, report edition-matched General Note 3(b) listing; Special-program membership stays unknown. Neither comparison establishes qualification or selects a column. Follow usitc_check_additional_duties for partial Chapter 99 research.
